title: Derive and check a causal three-send BIT rewrite solver
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Three mutable sends and fixed readouts reduce to at most eight GF(2) linear systems. Free terminal decoders add a separate quotient branch. The nominated grade-1 + grade-1 to grade-2 contraction fails all 128 assignments with arbitrary final decoders, certified by the two-coordinate input that leaves chart 527’s stock at zero. The companion certifies 6,784 additional branches for 53 earlier senders, plus the separately tested 3413 bypass.

## Task and overlap

This is a refined follow-up to [#7852](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7852) at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The baseline is [#7830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7830) at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`, with native source `89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af`. Earlier fixed-packet and bounded redecoding contexts [#7978](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7978) at `dd529bbb031cf87b424d43841a88a009773fa24b`, [#7985](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7985) at `251e15df3e0c058a843e7cb13f5882179a4e3afc` and finite admission [#7973](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7973) at `ac3df5d5c8889f464f575e32dfea43714abf08ca`, [#7975](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7975) at `46368d288e9dfad1cffce2af5094cbedfe84cb06`. The source word matches byte for byte and the three baseline JSON receipts record normalized trailing newlines. ChatGPT Pro supplied the synthesis derivation and initial seed. Separate Codex workers checked and extended it.

## Validation

In a fresh Python 3.12 extraction check `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and run the two documented replay sections. Independent primitive extraction, all 128 assignments, the 800-case theorem suite, a corrupted separator, a fixed-versus-free readout control, and the 6,784-branch cold checks passed.

## Open next questions

Change the information reaching both affected banks without losing the paid saving. Any successful packet witness still needs both literal orientations, owned erasure, compiler, precision and the complete 48/36-call finite application.

## Credit

Clear1nsight prepared this package with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the original caller, supplier and verifier authors identified in the source notices.
